name: claude-control
description: Manage persistent local Claude sessions from Codex with explicit models and verified results.

interface.shortDescription: Manage local Sonnet and Fable sessions.
interface.longDescription: Manage local Claude sessions, task revisions, queues, bounded review workflows and explicit plan-edit-review compositions. Workspace policies add controller-mediated edits, isolated named checks and frozen results for Codex approval. Linux only; native Claude tools and cross-host dispatch remain disabled.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Claude Control to delegate a local task and verify its result.
